assessments.reasoning: The SPDX repository’s annotated object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b names v3.29.0 and targets object type commit, SHA 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. GitHub reports the tag unsigned. Repository provenance supports the documentary release binding.

The official generated detail at that commit supplies the exact ID, nondeprecated status, BY title and GovData reference. The German and English clauses describe conditional attribution, including provision of the source-note information by the data holder.
Frankfurt’s digest-bound municipal text supplies the publisher-side context through its full German title, operative attribution provisions and link to the exact edition cited by SPDX.

GovData’s own BY 2.0 article associates the same URL with Namensnennung and describes the source-note elements. Its separate listing of Zero resolves the sibling-edition challenge. Its authority here concerns GovData’s identification of the reference.

challenge.method: Compared the tag object and commit target against the detail URL, then compared the case-sensitive identifier, deprecation field, name, crossRef, seeAlso and licence text against the municipal and GovData sources. Tested substitution of Zero, attribution of the SPDX reference directly to Frankfurt and exact equivalence of the texts.
challenge.results: The detail identifies DL-DE-BY-2.0, marks isDeprecatedLicenseId false and names Data licence Germany – attribution – version 2.0. Both structured references use the HTTPS GovData BY route. The text’s trailing HTTP reference preserves the same host and path. Frankfurt’s repeated sentence is absent from the corresponding SPDX attribution list. The evidence connects Frankfurt to SPDX through the named GovData edition and excludes the Zero record.

limitations: This establishes the documentary correspondence in SPDX Data 3.29.0. Text equivalence, XML build lineage, current link behavior and grants for particular works require separate evidence.

The GovData BY legal-page URL occurs in the three inspected documents. The requested acquisitions cover Frankfurt’s legal text and GovData’s documentation, without a separate capture of that destination.
reasoning: SCES §7 requires an external index assertion to be pinned to its owner’s release or record revision. The annotated SPDX Data tag identifies the exact commit serving DL-DE-BY-2.0.json. That detail names attribution version 2.0 and refers to the same GovData BY route as Frankfurt and GovData’s documentation. Its bilingual licence text also identifies the edition through the source-note and change-marking clauses.
